description: MAP-5 / MAP-7: an explicit reasoning dial on a server whose compat has no reasoning field (thinking_format='none': ollama, LM Studio) raises at build time. Before this date the reference and the TypeScript port sent the request with the dial silently omitted; the Rust port refused. A dial the caller set and the wire cannot carry is a raise, never an omission. No wire request.

provenance.evidence: the ollama preset's thinking_format is 'none' (lm15-python lm15/compat.py, OPENAI_CHAT_PRESETS['ollama']; the TypeScript and Rust tables are copies); docs/mapping-rules.md MAP-5 (a setting the dialect cannot carry raises) and MAP-7 rule 2 (an effort word with no native level raises client-side rather than downgrading silently); found by lm15-ts/tests/provider_examples.test.ts building the same request in three languages (Rust refused, the others did not); changes/2026-09-11-reasoning-dial-without-a-field.md

canonical_request_provenance.evidence: the smallest request that sets the dial on the keyless local preset; the refusal is the pinned outcome (lm15-rs src/dialects/openai_chat/payload.rs already raised it; lm15-python and lm15-ts corrected in the same change)
